interface.name: start
interface.description: Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump

interface.name: stop
interface.description: Stop button, used to stop all pumps

interface.name: pumpGroup
interface.description: Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd.

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Stop wins over a simultaneous start.
Read-only priority and selection fields must be unchanged.
assumptions: stop has priority over start and clears all five commands.
A start command selects the running set from current mode/configuration; commands are retained while neither button is TRUE. There is no automatic selection change until another start.
Equal priorities are resolved by lower array index first. Selection is ignored in automatic mode.
The caller initializes every RunComd FALSE before creating the first operational scan. Only RunComd may be written.

formal_properties.explanation: Manual start uses exactly the selected pumps.

formal_properties.formula: G((!stop & start & mode) -> (forall i in 1..5: runs[i]=(i in top3)))
formal_properties.explanation: Automatic start runs exactly the highest-priority three.
The FB may not modify priorities or selections.

atomic_propositions.top3: The three indices with highest priority, lower index winning a tie.
atomic_propositions.runPrev[i]: The pre-scan RunComd value of pump i.
atomic_propositions.readOnlyPreserved: All five priority and selection values equal their sampled values.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or output.
